increment_clock: Conventional 12-hour BCD carry: seconds 59->00 carries minutes, minutes 59->00 carries hours, hours 12->01, pm toggles on 11->12.
When ss=0x59 and ena=1, ss wraps to 0x00 but mm is not incremented.
Alternative carry or AM/PM phase, such as toggling pm on 12->01 or at a different rollover boundary.
